# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_005_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 5

**1** Jesus said: "Come to know what is right in front of you, and what has been hidden will be revealed to you.

**2** For nothing that is hidden will remain concealed,

**3** and nothing buried will stay underground."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Right in front of you" — "before your face" rendered with immediacy; the divine is not far off
- "What has been hidden will be revealed" — passive divine; the hiddenness is temporary
- "Remain concealed" — captures the negative permanence
- "Stay underground" — renders the burial/raising image concretely; the resurrection resonance is implicit
